findings.evidence: Architecture: "Retry on failure"; the spec never says how many times or what failure means
findings.recommendation: Specify retry limits, timeout, and success criteria

findings.evidence: Architecture: no existing queue or worker design named
findings.recommendation: Compare direct calls, existing job queue, and outbox with evidence from the repo

findings.evidence: Failure Modes: "Use exponential backoff. TODO: choose when to stop"
findings.recommendation: Specify max attempts, dead-letter behavior, backpressure and how to avoid duplicate side effects

findings.evidence: Architecture: "call the webhook URL stored on the customer account" with no URL validation/authentication
findings.recommendation: Define ownership authorization, outbound URL restrictions (SSRF protection), signed messages, and secret handling

findings.evidence: Implementation Plan: "Endpoint location TBD" with no file mapping or data model
findings.recommendation: Inspect repository and define concrete files, table schema and acceptance tests
